Subject: Vendor onboarding — procurement/security worksheet & PO path

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro this morning. We're getting the paperwork queued on our side — attached is Hivelogic's procurement worksheet with the fields your finance team typically needs (billing address, tax ID, remit instructions). Can you confirm Redwood's DPA and latest SOC 2 report are available to exchange with our privacy team? Also: we need a current subprocessor inventory (or a link) and your preferred PO routing (billing email + remit address) so we can create the PO.

Timeline: procurement hopes to issue a PO within 3–5 business days once we have the DPA and subprocessor list. If there are any compliance outliers (third-party subcontractors we need redaction guidance for), let us know.

Attachment: hivelogic-procurement-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Appreciate it —
Elena Morales
Procurement Operations | Hivelogic
elena.morales@hivelogic.com | +1 415-555-0182

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — procurement/security worksheet & PO path

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending the worksheet — received and looks straightforward. Quick summary of what I'm attaching/ linking here so procurement has everything in one place:

- Redwood DPA (draft for signature) — attached as Redwood-DPA-draft.pdf and we will send an eSign link once you confirm the billing/PO details.
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) — hosted link below for your privacy team to download.
- Subprocessor inventory (current) — CSV attached (redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv). If you need a version with limited vendor contact details redacted for procurement review, say the word and we can redact phone/email columns.
- PO & invoicing routing: please route POs to billing@redwoodinference.com. Invoices should reference the PO number and be emailed to ap@redwoodinference.com. Our remit/bill-to address is in the attached worksheet too.

Doc links/attachments:
- SOC 2: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/Redwood-SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf
- DocuSign (DPA) will be sent after you confirm PO number and billing address: https://na3.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na3&acct=12345&ppid=abcd-1234

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-draft.pdf; redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the PO number + bill-to name and remit address for invoicing.
2) Karthik will validate tax/tax-ID fields and finalize the DocuSign DPA.
3) Once DPA is signed, procurement issues PO and we route invoice to AP.

Karthik — looping you in to validate the procurement worksheet and confirm whether we need a vendor-level W-9 or equivalent for Hivelogic (they're US-based). Ben — FYI on timeline (3–5 business days on their end).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Elena —

Quick procurement validation questions so we can keep to your 3–5 day target:

1) Legal entity & Tax ID (EIN) for the PO: please confirm full legal name as it should appear on the PO and the W-9/EIN.
2) Remit address for wire/ACH if different from the billing address on the worksheet.
3) Do you require any special PO terms (net 30 / net 45) or grouping for multiple line items? We typically default to net 30.

Also: I will send the DPA via DocuSign once you confirm the PO number and legal entity. If your privacy team needs a redacted subprocessor inventory (we can remove support contact emails and internal account managers), let me know which columns to exclude and I will produce that version.

No attachments from me — I'll convert the DPA draft to an eSign package after the above and share the signed copy once complete.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Contracts & Procurement | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199
